name: Joshua Aaron Rotenberg
headline: Administrative & Operations Coordinator
summary: Operations and administrative professional with 15+ years managing client accounts, onboarding, hiring, and reporting systems in fast-paced service organizations, with hands-on cash handling, till reconciliation, and bank-deposit experience in a cash-intensive retail environment. Directly managed and developed onboarding teams as large as 20, standardized data and reporting processes, and kept multi-account operations organized and accurate under deadline pressure.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Own the primary strategic relationship for a portfolio of service-based businesses, running discovery and onboarding to surface client goals and objectives.

experience.title: Onboarding & Training Coordinator — Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Led onboarding and training for a diverse, high-volume partner network, driving rapid adoption of new tools and processes.
Onboarded and managed 15–20 partner accounts, retaining all but one (~94% retention) during tenure.
Analyzed partner utilization and performance metrics to identify adoption gaps and recommend interventions.

experience.title: Sales Team Lead — Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Took on team lead responsibilities for the sales team alongside individual account management.
Built and refined internal processes that improved reporting accuracy, reduced handoff errors, and strengthened cross-team alignment.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Directly managed and developed a team of onboarding specialists for 2 years — a team of 20, later a team of 8 — overseeing budgets, scope, and delivery for a high-value client portfolio.

Contributed to hiring, onboarding, and training of new hires, and developed training materials for tenured team members, as part of building a new business vertical from proof of concept to a profitable line (corroborated by direct manager's written recommendation).
Onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month, holding 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets.

experience.title: Co-Owner / Operations Lead
bullets: Personally and regularly handled cash counting, till reconciliation, and bank deposits in a cash-intensive retail environment.
Built compliance and customer-management systems from scratch in a licensed cannabis dispensary.
Developed early operational infrastructure — intake processes and reporting systems — scaling the business to profitability.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science — Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO
